_description: Tracks improvement scores across automated cycles.

cycles.root_cause: _build_distilled_indicator_query checked 'employment_rate' cue BEFORE 'unemployment' cue. Since 'unemployment rate' produces both cues, the employment_rate match fired first and returned 'employment rate' (dropping 'un' prefix). The entire resolution pipeline then searched for the wrong indicator.
cycles.fix_description: Moved 'unemployment' cue check before 'employment_rate' in _build_distilled_indicator_query. Now 'unemployment rate in Japan' correctly distills to 'unemployment rate' → resolves to SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS → fetches real data.
